paper_title: Think-on-Graph 2.0: Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Graph-guided Retrieval
subject: Think-on-Graph 2.0
evidence_quote:
We evaluated our method on different knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmark datasets, including
two multi-hop KBQA datasets WebQSP (Yih et al., 2016) and QALD10-en (Usbeck et al., 2023), a
multi-hop complex document QA dataset AdvHotpotQA (Ye & Durrett, 2022) which is a challeng-
ing subset of HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018), a slot filling dataset Zero-Shot RE(Petroni et al., 2021),
and two fact verification dataset FEVER (Thorne et al., 2018) and Creak (Onoe et al., 2021).
source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
